title: Ford Vows Not to Sell Customer Driving Data
excerpt: Ford has announced a new privacy promise stating it will never sell customer driving data to third-party data brokers.
body_html: Automaker Ford has committed to never selling customer driving data to third-party data brokers. The new privacy promise is designed to differentiate the company from competitors that have previously faced regulatory scrutiny and legal issues for sharing telematics data without proper authorization. Alongside this commitment, Ford stated it will work to protect customer information as part of its updated privacy approach.
